Fluency Arcade · MTSS-ready reporting module v1 · Sample date is fixed for reproducible review. Data contract and integration notes
SAMPLE STUDENT RECORD

Clear measures. Clear decisions.

Three seconds per practice card. Typed answers check automatically. Timeout and incorrect answers are distinct outcomes. A single success can clear today's card without confirming long-term mastery.

Current pilot milestones: success, another day at least 1 day later, another at least 3 days later, then another at least 7 days later. Confirmed facts return for maintenance after 14 days. A missed confirmed fact requires refreshing. This dashboard reads recorded stages; it never promotes a fact itself.

Learning = stage 0 or needs refresh. Strengthening = stages 1–2. Provisional = stage 3. Confirmed = stage 4 without refresh. Never-seen facts are included in Learning, not described as incorrect.

Confirmed fact rate: confirmed student-fact records divided by assigned student-fact records. Full-set retention: students with every assigned fact in the selected pathway currently confirmed, divided by rostered students.

90-second checks: median correct count and median accuracy from each student's latest valid official check. The two medians may represent different students. Incorrect and timeout totals describe only those checks, not all practice.

Coverage: students with a current valid official check divided by the filtered roster. Practice participation means at least one non-demo session in the last seven calendar days.

Growth uses stored snapshots for students present at both endpoints of the selected window. Intermediate points appear only with complete data for that matched cohort. Pilot criteria are not a validated state proficiency measure. Instructional groups are suggestions for teacher review, not automatic MTSS tier or eligibility decisions.

This public preview contains synthetic data only. Production permissions must be enforced by MTSS on the server. The view buttons are not authentication.
